items.item_text: Required to hold a valid California driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program

Experience interpreting and applying complex admission guidelines to render appropriate admission decisions across a wide range of unique academic and life circumstances, including four year universities.
Travel experience for recruitment and outreach activities in-state and out-of-state.
Experience in student recruitment and/or yield programs and knowledge of K-12 and higher education systems.

Professional experience with verbal and written communication, the skill to provide and receive clear, concise information, and effectively communicate on an individual and group basis with demonstrated skill to develop and deliver presentations.

Experience with and proven skill to work cooperatively and sensitively with individuals from diverse cultures, ethnic groups, lifestyles, and backgrounds with demonstrated awareness of cross-cultural and intercultural distinctions with prospective students, their families, school and community officials, campus colleagues, and the general public.

Data, information and computer literacy with demonstrated knowledge and experience using standard computing tools including Microsoft Office applications, email, and web-based research tools and student database management programs.

Under general supervision of the Director and Associate Director, recruit and provide undergraduate admissions advising for domestic resident and non-resident prospective, admitted, and current UC Davis students. Interpret and implement policies from the UC Regents, UC Academic Senate Board of Admissions and Relations with Schools, UC Office of the President, UC Davis Academic Senate Admissions and Enrollment Committee, and UC Davis Undergraduate Admissions. Provide consultation and input to leadership on UC Davis pre-collegiate educational programs, admissions marketing and recruitment, publications, policies, and practices. Review freshman and transfer applications annually, rendering admission decisions. Explain and clarify admission and selection policies and processes to prospective students, families, counselors and higher education administrators. Guide admitted students, families, and counselors with admissions and course evaluation issues. Participate and enhance recruitment and yield programs at targeted prospective students. Provide outreach to diverse student populations at high schools, colleges, and community based agencies and organizations. Represent and speak on behalf of UC Davis and the University at professional meetings and conferences of educators and colleagues. Admit undergraduate students to the University, including admission by exception; establish and modify admission contracts; sustain and rescind admission offers; exercise professional judgment in the comprehensive review of applicants for selective admissions; counsel and consult prospective, provisionally admitted, denied, reinstated, and matriculated students; provide program coordination of academic department admission reviews, perform credit adjustments for continuing students, deferred student enrollment, and other interoffice and student programs; implement and administer admission and evaluation policy.
Skill to work under pressure of immediate deadlines and constantly shifting priorities.
Working knowledge of academic programs, including curricula, admissions requirements, and financial aid programs.
Familiarity with or skill to learn campus policies, procedures, and practices in the areas of student pre-collegiate programs.
Knowledge of languages other than English, both written and oral.
